$comment: Simplified Chinese typography, following macOS zh-CN (Finder, AppKit, and System Settings quote names with “…” only; nested ‘…’ per GB/T 15834). No apostrophe: Chinese has none. Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: one space between Han text and a Latin word or a digit (`macOS 内建`, `3 个文件`)

hedges.why: a bracketed plural or measure word; Chinese needs none, one measure word reads right for any count
a gendered pronoun pair; address the user as 你 or name the thing
an English bracketed plural left in; drop it, Chinese has no plural ending
